Arunodaya Infrastructure 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Jharkhand · IN
 
 No. CC/31/2017/150 
 Dated: 31 Mar 2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Rural Road Upgradation - Jharkhand Pkg-150" (roads maintenance), awarded to M/s National
 Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 26 Sep 2017 at a
 gross executed value of Rs. 299.00 Lakh (Rupees 2.99 Crore Only). 
 On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the workmanship conforming to the
 technical specifications forming part of the contract. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Divya Singh. This certificate is issued for record and for submission with future
 tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Arunodaya Infrastructure
